english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for valuing someone or something deeply and holding it dear.
Use this when you value something because you cherish it and do not want to lose it.
Use this when valuing something by cherishing it and not taking it for granted, such as time or opportunities.

examples.traditional: 我真係好珍惜呢段友誼。

examples.english: We will always value this friendship.
examples.traditional: 呢段友情，我哋一定會珍惜。

examples.english: We should appreciate the time we have to eat together.
examples.traditional: 我哋要珍惜一齊食飯嘅時間。
